capabilities.description: 可信工作流调用的因子数值计算，支持时序与截面。九项诊断按任务选择，包括 DSR 和完整试验收益矩阵的 CSCV/PBO；只让用户明确的硬要求限制选择，保留条件证据、失败试验与不可算原因。

inputRef.description: Exact published data ArtifactRef returned by a declared capability. Alternative to dataset_id; no paths, mutable heads or guessed IDs.

dataset.description: Chronological splits, optional mode:auto|cross-sectional|time-series (auto selects time-series for one symbol), horizon, costBps and quantile. Time-series metrics average per-symbol correlations equally; direction diagnostics use training-only quantiles.

minRankIC.description: Legacy advisory threshold in 1.2.0; supplying an Agent argument is not a user hard requirement. Use evaluationPlan.thresholds with source:user AND mode:required only when the user explicitly requires a gate.

minCoverage.description: Legacy advisory threshold in 1.2.0; supplying an Agent argument is not a user hard requirement. Use evaluationPlan.thresholds with source:user AND mode:required only when the user explicitly requires a gate.

maxCorrelation.description: Legacy advisory threshold in 1.2.0; supplying an Agent argument is not a user hard requirement. Use evaluationPlan.thresholds with source:user AND mode:required only when the user explicitly requires a gate.

diagnostics.description: Choose only diagnostics relevant to the task. Omitted/false items are not-requested; individual inapplicable, unavailable or erroneous diagnostics do not block the others or candidate selection. This is not a mandatory checklist.

placebo.description: Optional null control. true or {samples:20..999,seed:uint32}; per-date label permutation or per-symbol circular shift.

monteCarlo.description: Optional empirical return-path simulation. true or {samples:20..999,seed:uint32,blockSize:integer}. Reports path return/drawdown dispersion, not significance.

outOfSample.description: Optional train/validation summary and sealed holdout status; true or {}. development-only has no sealed holdout; restricted holdout is deferred until finalize.

walkForward.description: Optional fixed-candidate expanding-window evaluation. true or {folds:2..8,minTrain:8..20000,minTest:4..20000,gap:>=horizon}. No repeated candidate discovery claim.

sensitivity.description: Optional local one-parameter AST neighborhood. true or {maxVariants:2..16,windowStep:1..20,constantFraction:>0..1}. No adjustable parameters is not-applicable.

regimes.description: Optional PIT state-field strata. {field:numericFieldName,bins:2..5,minObservations:4..20000}; missing field is unavailable. Quantile thresholds fit training only.

bootstrap.description: Optional block/paired percentile confidence intervals. true or {samples:20..999,seed:uint32,blockSize:integer,confidence:0.5..0.999}. Not an IID or BCa claim.

dsr.description: Optional DSR at select, using every registered trial return series. true or {independentTrials:integer,reason:string}; override requires a reason, otherwise independence of all trials is an explicit assumption. Candidate status deferred. No winner-only fallback.

pbo.description: Optional exact CSCV/PBO at select on the complete synchronous trial return matrix. true or {blocks:even integer 2..16}; equal blocks must exactly divide periods with 2+ rows each. Missing/failed/nonaligned trials remain unavailable, not dropped.

evaluationPlan.description: Frozen task-selected plan. tests overrides diagnostics item by item. Defaults are advisory. Only an explicitly user-sourced required threshold gates; do not relabel an Agent preference as user. No holdout metrics or aggregate score.

metric.description: Numeric path from metrics: validation.rankIC, diagnostics.dsr.probability, diagnostics.pbo.probability, diagnostics.regimes.strata.0.rankIC, or redundancy.absoluteCorrelation. No holdout paths.

accepted_ids.description: Explicit previously measured candidate IDs for training-only redundancy comparison. Workflows normally supply already accepted candidates, or [] when none has been accepted. Every referenced ID must have an existing candidate receipt.

trial_ids.description: Frozen shortlist for select: include only IDs whose actual candidate receipt has eligible:true. Retained rejected/failed trials are audit evidence, not selection members. [] is valid if none qualifies.

selection_digest.description: Exact selectionDigest returned by the immutable select receipt. Never calculate or invent a substitute.

eligible.description: Measurable validation or identified development-subset evidence and no explicit user hard failure; conditional does not imply global validity. Required search diagnostics defer to select.

evaluation.description: status measured|conditional|not-evaluable, measuredEvidence, conditions, limitations, thresholdResults, compact hardRequirementFailures/pendingHardRequirements/advisoryFindings and planDigest. Finding thresholdIndex points to the full thresholdResults entry. Development conditions are exploratory, not independently validated; invalidations retains missing subsets and unmet-threshold references.

usage.purpose: 可信工作流调用的因子数值计算，支持时序与截面。九项诊断按任务选择，包括 DSR 和完整试验收益矩阵的 CSCV/PBO；只让用户明确的硬要求限制选择，保留条件证据、失败试验与不可算原因。
usage.inputs: Every nested call uses {protocol:"sesame.factor-evaluator/v1",action,run_id}. prepare adds access,options.dataset and exactly one input: dataset_id or options.inputRef (complete fixed data ArtifactRef). auto_factor_start forwards config.evaluator.arguments as options; for a fixed Ref put inputRef there and omit dataset_id. candidate adds session_id,trial_id,candidate,accepted_ids; select adds session_id,trial_ids; finalize adds session_id,selection_digest. Candidate example: {op:"field",name:"signal"}; the exact contract is returned by prepare. options.dataset.mode supports auto, cross-sectional and time-series. options.diagnostics selects placebo, monteCarlo, outOfSample, walkForward, sensitivity, regimes, bootstrap, dsr and pbo; omitted items do not run. evaluationPlan:{tests,thresholds,reasons} overrides diagnostics by item. Threshold entries {metric,value,operator,mode,source,reason}; only mode:required AND source:user gates. Legacy thresholds are advisory. Keep plan within 12KB, threshold entries within 8KB.
usage.outputs: Host Run output always has protocol/action/runId/sessionId/receiptDigest. prepare => inputDigest,data,development.rows,contract; fixed input data retains full inputRefs,provenance,dependencies and incorporates the exact Ref into its frozen digest. candidate => trialId,candidate,candidateDigest,metrics,eligible,evaluation,gate,redundancy; select => exact trialIds,selectionDigest,diagnostics,evaluations,failedTrials,planDigest; finalize => holdout,holdoutStatus,archive. Return receipts and actual coverage/limitations for synthesis; same-dataset metrics are related evidence, not independent confirmations. metrics.diagnostics retains every requested result with status completed|partial|not-requested|not-applicable|unavailable|deferred|error and a reason when needed; completed means computed, not scientifically passed. metrics.diagnosticPlan makes the plan reproducible. See DIAGNOSTICS.md for configuration and assumptions.
prerequisites: Trusted workflow nested invocation only; a direct Agent call is rejected. Public workflow entry: auto_factor_start with evaluator:{plugin_id:"sesame/factor-evaluator",tool:"factor_evaluate",arguments:<README dataset/gate options>}; another implementation of the same protocol is also valid.

Registered dataset_id or complete fixed kind:data/schemaVersion:1.0.0 inputRef containing json-rows, exactly one. Rows are {time,symbol,availableAt,fields:{close,...finite numbers}}, no duplicate time/symbol, availableAt<=time, at most20000 rows/4MiB. A single symbol is valid for time-series mode; cross-sectional mode needs four aligned assets for its metrics.
limitations: Only eligible measured trial IDs can be selected; selection_digest is the exact select receipt, not a guessed hash. Same run/session/trial inputs are immutable and idempotent.

restricted isolates workflow holdout until selection; development-only rejects post-validation rows and returns holdoutStatus=not-requested. Built-in AST computation is not arbitrary code or broker backtesting.

DataRef is consumed without registering a new host dataset or converting raw market rows. The caller must preserve inputRefs as archive dependencies and keep complete source refs/provenance out of restricted research-role context before selection; published refs are readable through host.resources.read.

The evaluator owns numerical evidence and immutable receipts. The caller owns information acquisition, candidate generation, complementary method selection and the final report; same-input retries reuse receipts instead of duplicating trials.

Time-series Rank IC is predictive association, not realized win rate or per-trade R. For actual fills/TP/SL, combine an execution-aware backtester and suitable knowledge; do not reject the research goal because this numerical primitive has narrower metrics.

DSR/PBO use all registered session trial diagnostic-portfolio return series at select, never only selected winners or holdout. Failed attempts and nonaligned returns make the statistic unavailable. Independence is an explicit DSR assumption; PBO evaluates maximum-Sharpe selection, not arbitrary Agent judgment.

knowledge.description: 工作流嵌套调用的计算原语：输入固定数据和因子 AST，输出实测/冗余/选择回执，明确由调用者负责综合。
冻结输入、候选及选择回执协议。
按任务选择九项诊断和阈值；DSR/PBO原始论文、完整试验前提、条件证据与不可算状态。
